name: paymatrix-android
description: Native Android shell and release tooling for PayMatrix

scripts.android:sync: npm run web:build && npm run web:validate && cap sync android
scripts.android:run: npm run android:sync && cap run android
scripts.android:apk: npm run android:sync && node scripts/gradle.mjs assembleDebug
scripts.android:aab: npm run android:sync && node scripts/gradle.mjs bundleRelease
